attribution.note: Marcus states and endorses the forecast in his own words.

semantics.note: The wording expresses firm confidence in some impact. No condition or deadline is stated; Q4 2023 concerns the separate AGI claim.

contract.note: Practical military or national-security adoption is a fair ordinary reading of some impact. Whether GPT-5 includes later GPT-5.x models is unspecified and materially affects resolution.

evidence.note: The dated report documents military availability of version 5.4 Terra, with 5.6 planned. It does not establish deployment of the specifically named GPT-5, although it would support a broader family reading.
The preprint reports military benchmarks for a different model against GPT-5. It establishes neither operational GPT-5 adoption nor a qualifying practical effect.

reviews.rationale: Neither item establishes a qualifying effect attributable specifically to GPT-5. The later-version deployment is material but leaves model scope unresolved. No deadline was stated, and no conclusive event under the contract establishes support or rules out future impact.
